title: Tate: a normal Noetherian domain complete along x with R/xR an N-2 domain is N-2
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $x\in R$. Assume (1) $R$ is a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] normal domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]; (2) the quotient ring $R/xR$ is an integral domain and is N-2 [def-weil-pbc-japanese-domain]; (3) $R$ is $xR$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], i.e. the canonical map $R\to\varprojlim_nR/x^nR$ is bijective. Then $R$ is N-2: for every finite field extension $L$ [def-pc-field-extension] of the fraction field $K$ of $R$, the integral closure of $R$ in $L$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure] is a finitely generated $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module].
